usedFor: Duply creates marketing images and videos, and Slack tells the team through “Send Message” when “New Image Created” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Image Created” in Duply, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The team sees each finished image in a channel and can review it without opening Duply.

watchOut: “New Image Created” in Duply is polling, and a channel post from an automation waits for your approval first.
